mapper.select: select id,scope,analyzer_type as analyzerType,analyzer_version as analyzerVersion,analyzer_config_hash as analyzerConfigHash,sample_definition_json as sampleDefinitionJson,trace_snapshot_at as traceSnapshotAt,idempotency_key as idempotencyKey,status,total_items as totalItems,succeeded_items as succeededItems,failed_items as failedItems,reserved_cost as reservedCost,actual_cost as actualCost,created_by as createdBy,created_at as createdAt,started_at as startedAt,completed_at as completedAt from trace_analysis_job where id=#{jobId}

select id,scope,analyzer_type as analyzerType,analyzer_version as analyzerVersion,analyzer_config_hash as analyzerConfigHash,sample_definition_json as sampleDefinitionJson,trace_snapshot_at as traceSnapshotAt,idempotency_key as idempotencyKey,status,total_items as totalItems,succeeded_items as succeededItems,failed_items as failedItems,reserved_cost as reservedCost,actual_cost as actualCost,created_by as createdBy,created_at as createdAt,started_at as startedAt,completed_at as completedAt from trace_analysis_job where idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}

select id,scope,analyzer_type as analyzerType,analyzer_version as analyzerVersion,analyzer_config_hash as analyzerConfigHash,sample_definition_json as sampleDefinitionJson,trace_snapshot_at as traceSnapshotAt,idempotency_key as idempotencyKey,status,total_items as totalItems,succeeded_items as succeededItems,failed_items as failedItems,reserved_cost as reservedCost,actual_cost as actualCost,created_by as createdBy,created_at as createdAt,started_at as startedAt,completed_at as completedAt from trace_analysis_job order by created_at desc limit #{limit}

select id,job_id as jobId,source_run_id as sourceRunId,analyzer_type as analyzerType,status,outcome_status as outcomeStatus,attempt,candidate_id as candidateId,latency_ms as latencyMs,estimated_cost as estimatedCost,error_class as errorClass,error_message as errorMessage from trace_analysis_item where job_id=#{jobId} order by id
mapper.insert: insert into trace_analysis_job (id,scope,analyzer_type,analyzer_version,analyzer_config_hash,sample_definition_json,trace_snapshot_at,idempotency_key,status,total_items,succeeded_items,failed_items,reserved_cost,actual_cost,created_by,created_at,started_at,completed_at) values (#{id},#{scope},#{analyzerType},#{analyzerVersion},#{analyzerConfigHash},#{sampleDefinitionJson},#{traceSnapshotAt},#{idempotencyKey},#{status},#{totalItems},#{succeededItems},#{failedItems},#{reservedCost},#{actualCost},#{createdBy},#{createdAt},#{startedAt},#{completedAt}) on duplicate key update id=id
